auditor: analytical-auditor (Sonnet, blind: claim and data paths only; the tool and the result were not read)
verdict: accept (with a corrected threshold label and a caveat on the placebo ratio)

reproduced.abs_diff: slope 0.0003; interval ends and MDE under 0.003

concerns: eligibility uses the pattern flag, distance, clean flag and covariate completeness only (no outcome or payload value): no leakage found; the 5 km floor removes most short urban drives (median 2.5 km)
payload varies within a day on 12 of 58 days (35 days have more than one drive): the slope is identified mostly between days, so confounding by day, route and occupants is not separable
highway has 4 eligible drives: the class adjustment is nearly saturated

displaced-day placebo: 92 of 121 drives match; placebo slope -0.168 [-0.786, 0.559] against a primary of about -0.014 on the subset: the ratio 12 to 13 against a primary near zero is unstable and not interpretable; the placebo interval includes zero
the reading-rule threshold depends on the mean fuel used (eligible mean 5.59 versus the corpus mean 7.46 L/100 km): 0.030 versus 0.040; the verdict does not change (MDE 0.672)
the first-drive-of-day flag is defined over all drives of the date in the payload file (15.7 % of eligible drives flagged); this detail was not pre-registered
reading_rule_check: 0.2 x 0.0526 x 5.59 = 0.059 is the LOWER end of the expectation; half of it is 0.030 (0.040 on the corpus mean); the realised MDE 0.672 exceeds every version by more than 15 times: 'not informative at this support' is applied correctly
